name: openroom
description: Prepare and deliver tutor-led sessions and live classroom interactions through OpenRoom without wrapping the preparation model.

interface.shortDescription: Prepare sessions externally and deliver them live.
interface.longDescription: Use this chat as the preparation workbench for local school documents, then save typed outlines, manage learners, launch sessions, and control tutor-led delivery through OpenRoom. Original documents stay here; OpenRoom stores only the structured deck.
defaultPrompt: Prepare an OpenRoom deck from these materials and show me a preview.
Revise this learner's next outline and save a new version.
Start this deck as a live session and help me run it.
